fields.desc_en: Design research that decenters the human: co-designing with other species, caring and noticing, and the methods and theory behind it.
fields.desc_zh: 把人从中心移开的设计研究：与其他物种共同设计、照护与留意，以及背后的方法与理论。

subs.desc_en: Co-designing with other species and designing for their needs alongside ours.
subs.desc_zh: 与其他物种共同设计，把它们的需要和人的需要放在一起考虑。

subs.desc_en: Designing for caring for, repairing and living alongside other beings and ecosystems.
subs.desc_zh: 为照料、修复其他生命和生态系统并与之共处而设计。

subs.desc_en: The arts of noticing as design practice: listening to, sensing and translating the signals and worlds of other beings.
subs.desc_zh: 把“留意的技艺”作为设计实践：倾听、感知并转译其他生命的信号与世界。

subs.desc_en: Participatory methods, personas, toolkits, workshops and consent mechanisms for designing with nonhumans.
subs.desc_zh: 与非人类一起设计的参与式方法、人物角色、工具包、工作坊和同意机制。

subs.desc_en: Theory, frameworks, reviews and manifestos for designing beyond the human.
subs.desc_zh: 超越人类的设计的理论、框架、综述与宣言。

fields.desc_en: Technology used by, designed with and designed for animals: pets, working animals, zoo residents, livestock and wildlife, and the ethics of involving them.
fields.desc_zh: 由动物使用、与动物一起设计、为动物设计的技术：宠物、工作犬、动物园居民、家畜和野生动物，以及让动物参与其中的伦理。

subs.desc_en: Devices that let pets call, play, rest and be understood at home.
subs.desc_zh: 让宠物在家里通话、玩耍、休息并被理解的设备。

subs.zh: 与动物一起的游戏、玩耍与机器人
subs.desc_en: Interspecies games and robots that play with, feed or care for animals.
subs.desc_zh: 跨物种游戏，以及陪动物玩耍、喂食或照料动物的机器人。

subs.desc_en: Interfaces for detection dogs, guide dogs, service animals and their handlers.
subs.desc_zh: 为检测犬、导盲犬、服务动物及其训导员设计的界面。

subs.desc_en: Interactive enrichment for primates, elephants, birds and other animals in care.
subs.desc_zh: 为灵长类、大象、鸟类等受照料动物设计的互动丰容。

subs.desc_en: Decoding and exchanging signals with whales, dolphins, birds and other species.
subs.desc_zh: 解码并与鲸、海豚、鸟类等物种交换信号。

subs.desc_en: Sensing, tracking and living alongside wild and farmed animals.
subs.desc_zh: 感知、追踪野生与养殖动物，并与它们共处。

subs.zh: 动物-计算机交互的理论、伦理与方法
subs.desc_en: Manifestos, ethics frameworks and methods for designing with animals as participants.
subs.desc_zh: 把动物当作参与者来设计的宣言、伦理框架与方法。

fields.desc_en: Technology that changes how people notice, experience and relate to nature: outdoors, in gardens, through citizen science, extended senses and mediated nature.
fields.desc_zh: 改变人如何注意、体验和对待自然的技术：户外、花园、公民科学、延伸的感官，以及被媒介化的自然。

subs.desc_en: Designs that slow people down and help them notice, attend to and feel connected with nature.
subs.desc_zh: 让人慢下来，去注意、关注并感到与自然相连的设计。

subs.desc_en: Interaction design for trails, forests, parks, mountains and water.
subs.desc_zh: 为步道、森林、公园、山地和水域设计的交互。

subs.desc_en: Tools that let people identify, record and monitor species and ecosystems.
subs.desc_zh: 让人识别、记录和监测物种与生态系统的工具。

subs.desc_en: Technology for growing food and plants and for caring for them day to day.
subs.desc_zh: 用于种植食物和植物、并在日常中照料它们的技术。

subs.desc_en: Experiences that let people perceive the world as other beings do: echolocation, UV vision, magnetic sense, plant time.
subs.desc_zh: 让人以其他生命的方式感知世界的体验：回声定位、紫外视觉、磁感、植物的时间尺度。

subs.desc_en: Making air, water, soil, climate and biodiversity data felt in everyday life.
subs.desc_zh: 让空气、水、土壤、气候和生物多样性的数据在日常生活中被感受到。

subs.desc_en: Nature rendered, simulated or augmented: VR forests, digital twins, generative ecosystems, technological nature.
subs.desc_zh: 被渲染、模拟或增强的自然：虚拟森林、数字孪生、生成式生态系统、技术化的自然。

subs.zh: 人与自然交互的理论与方法
subs.desc_en: Frameworks, reviews and methods for studying and designing human–nature interaction.
subs.desc_zh: 研究和设计人与自然交互的框架、综述与方法。

fields.desc_en: Living organisms as material and collaborator: grown materials, microbial fabrication, living architecture and bio art.
fields.desc_zh: 把生命当作材料和合作者：生长出来的材料、微生物制造、活体建筑与生物艺术。

subs.desc_en: Objects, packaging, leather and buildings grown from fungal mycelium.
subs.desc_zh: 用真菌菌丝体生长出的物件、包装、皮革和建筑。

subs.desc_en: Bacteria and yeast that make pigments, cellulose, cement and other materials.
subs.desc_zh: 让细菌和酵母制造色素、纤维素、水泥等材料。

subs.desc_en: Algae and photosynthetic organisms in products, facades and energy systems.
subs.desc_zh: 把藻类和光合生物用在产品、立面和能源系统里。

subs.desc_en: Guiding roots, trees and plants to grow into furniture, textiles and structures.
subs.desc_zh: 引导根系、树木和植物长成家具、织物和结构。

subs.desc_en: Garments and textiles dyed, grown or animated by living organisms.
subs.desc_zh: 由生命染色、生长或驱动的服装与织物。

subs.desc_en: Materials that move, change colour or shape using living cells or biological mechanisms.
subs.desc_zh: 利用活细胞或生物机制改变形状、颜色或运动的材料。

subs.desc_en: Buildings and structures that grow, breathe, repair or host life.
subs.desc_zh: 会生长、呼吸、自我修复或容纳生命的建筑与结构。

subs.zh: 生物 3D 打印与生物制造
subs.desc_en: 3D printing and robotic fabrication with living cells, hydrogels and biological materials.
subs.desc_zh: 用活细胞、水凝胶和生物材料进行 3D 打印和机器人制造。

subs.zh: 基因与合成生物学设计
subs.desc_en: Designers working with genetically modified and engineered organisms: glowing plants, edited microbes, new species and their speculative futures.
subs.desc_zh: 与基因改造和工程生物合作的设计：发光植物、编辑过的微生物、新物种，以及它们的思辨未来。

subs.desc_en: Art that uses living tissue, cells, bacteria or genes as its medium.
subs.desc_zh: 以活体组织、细胞、细菌或基因为媒介的艺术。

fields.desc_en: Interfaces and computers that include living organisms: plants as sensors, fungi and slime moulds that compute, microbes in wearables, biohybrid robots.
fields.desc_zh: 包含活体生物的界面与计算机：植物当传感器、会计算的真菌和黏菌、可穿戴设备里的微生物、生物混合机器人。

subs.desc_en: Devices and displays with living organisms inside, and how people care for them.
subs.desc_zh: 内部含有活体生物的设备和显示，以及人如何照料它们。

subs.desc_en: Plants as touch sensors, displays, antennas and robots.
subs.desc_zh: 把植物变成触摸传感器、显示器、天线和机器人。

subs.desc_en: Mycelium and slime moulds that sense, signal and solve problems.
subs.desc_zh: 会感知、传递信号和解决问题的菌丝体与黏菌。

subs.desc_en: Engineered or natural microbes as sensors, displays and on-body companions.
subs.desc_zh: 把天然或改造的微生物当作传感器、显示器和身上的伙伴。

subs.desc_en: Robots driven by muscle, cells, fungi or whole organisms.
subs.desc_zh: 由肌肉、细胞、真菌或整个生物驱动的机器人。

subs.desc_en: Computing and storing information with DNA, proteins and chemical reactions.
subs.desc_zh: 用 DNA、蛋白质和化学反应来计算和存储信息。

subs.desc_en: Interfaces that couple the human body directly with other living systems.
subs.desc_zh: 把人的身体直接与其他生命系统连接起来的界面。

fields.desc_en: Brain organoids and living neurons as computers: research, platforms, art and the design and ethics questions they raise.
fields.desc_zh: 把脑类器官和活神经元当作计算机：研究、平台、艺术，以及它们带来的设计与伦理问题。

subs.desc_en: Organoids and neuron cultures that learn, play games and compute.
subs.desc_zh: 能学习、玩游戏和计算的类器官与神经元培养物。

subs.desc_en: Platforms, hardware and interfaces for growing, reading and talking to living neurons.
subs.desc_zh: 培养、读取活体神经元并与之交流的平台、硬件和界面。

subs.desc_en: Artworks in which living neurons draw, compose or perform.
subs.desc_zh: 由活神经元绘画、作曲或表演的艺术作品。

subs.desc_en: Consciousness, consent and the futures of computing with living brains.
subs.desc_zh: 意识、同意，以及用活体大脑计算的未来。

fields.desc_en: Art made with, for and about other species and ecosystems: interspecies art, restorative and land art, ecological media and installations.
fields.desc_zh: 与其他物种和生态系统一起、为它们、关于它们的艺术：跨物种艺术、修复与大地艺术、生态媒介与装置。

subs.desc_en: Artworks made with, by or for other living beings.
subs.desc_zh: 与其他生命一起、由它们或为它们创作的艺术。

subs.desc_en: Interventions in land, water and soil that repair, remediate or reveal ecosystems.
subs.desc_zh: 介入土地、水和土壤，修复、净化或揭示生态系统的艺术。

subs.zh: 生态媒介、声音与数据艺术
subs.desc_en: Making ecological processes perceptible through sound, data, film and sensors.
subs.desc_zh: 通过声音、数据、影像和传感器让生态过程变得可感知。

subs.desc_en: Installations and environments about ecology, extinction, climate and other species.
subs.desc_zh: 关于生态、灭绝、气候和其他物种的装置与环境。

fields.desc_en: Design fiction, the rights and politics of nonhumans, and new myths and rituals for living with other beings.
fields.desc_zh: 设计虚构、非人类的权利与政治，以及与其他生命共处的新神话和仪式。

subs.desc_en: Critical and speculative design, future scenarios and fictional organisms and products.
subs.desc_zh: 批判与思辨设计、未来情境、虚构的生物与产品。

subs.desc_en: Rights of nature, legal personhood, parliaments and embassies of nonhumans, multispecies justice and governance.
subs.desc_zh: 自然权利、法律人格、非人类的议会与大使馆、多物种正义与治理。

subs.desc_en: Invented and revived myths, rituals and cosmologies for relating to other beings.
subs.desc_zh: 新编或复兴的神话、仪式与宇宙观，用来与其他生命建立关系。

fields.desc_en: AI that decodes animal communication, speaks for nonhumans, watches over ecosystems, simulates artificial life, or raises questions of nonhuman minds.
fields.desc_zh: 解码动物交流、为非人类发声、守护生态系统、模拟人工生命，或引出非人类心智问题的 AI。

subs.desc_en: Machine learning for animal vocalisation, communication and translation.
subs.desc_zh: 用机器学习研究动物发声、交流与翻译。

subs.zh: 非人类之声与 AI 代理
subs.desc_en: Language models and AI agents that speak for animals, plants, rivers, foods and forests.
subs.desc_zh: 为动物、植物、河流、食物和森林发声的语言模型与 AI 代理。

subs.desc_en: Machine learning for monitoring species, habitats and environments.
subs.desc_zh: 用机器学习监测物种、栖息地和环境。

subs.desc_en: Artificial life, simulated ecosystems, evolved creatures and generative nature.
subs.desc_zh: 人工生命、模拟生态系统、演化生物与生成式自然。

subs.zh: 感知能力、数字心智与 AI 伦理
subs.desc_en: Nonhuman and digital sentience, welfare, and the ethics and law of AI for other beings.
subs.desc_zh: 非人类与数字心智的感知能力与福祉，以及面向其他生命的 AI 伦理与法律。

collections.en: Entangled Life and Code (Breed et al., CHI 2026)
collections.desc_en: The 71 bio-digital systems across HCI, design and engineering analysed in Breed, Karana, Bozzon & Song's computational design taxonomy for synergistic bio-digital systems (Table 4). Each work's keywords carry the paper's coding. Companion explorer: biodigitalviz.github.io.
collections.desc_zh: Breed、Karana、Bozzon 与 Song 在“协同生物-数字系统的计算设计分类法”中分析的 71 个横跨人机交互、设计与工程的生物-数字系统（表 4）。每件作品的关键词记录了论文对它的编码。配套浏览站点：biodigitalviz.github.io。

collections.en: Aesthetics in Designing with the Living (Ikeya et al. 2025)
collections.zh: 《Aesthetics in Designing with the Living》（Ikeya 等，CHI 2025）
collections.desc_en: The artefacts reviewed in Ikeya, Barati & Wensveen's CHI 2025 systematic review of critical perspectives and aesthetics in designing with living organisms.
collections.desc_zh: Ikeya、Barati 与 Wensveen 在 CHI 2025 系统综述中审视的作品：关于“与生命一起设计”的批判视角与美学。

collections.zh: 后人类中心主义作品（Kneile 等，TOCHI 2025）
collections.desc_en: The 114 post-anthropocentric artifacts that mediate human–nature relations, extracted from 53 papers in Kneile, Dörrenbächer, Hassenzahl & Laschke's TOCHI scoping review, with the seven design strategies they identify. Companion archive: artifact-archive.org.
collections.desc_zh: Kneile、Dörrenbächer、Hassenzahl 与 Laschke 在 TOCHI 范围综述中，从 53 篇论文里提取的 114 件调解人与自然关系的后人类中心主义作品，以及他们归纳的七种设计策略。配套档案：artifact-archive.org。

collections.zh: BAD Award（生物艺术与设计奖）
collections.desc_en: Winners and nominees of the Bio Art & Design Award (ZonMw, NWO and MU Hybrid Art House, Netherlands), which pairs artists and designers with biomedical labs.
collections.desc_zh: 荷兰生物艺术与设计奖（由 ZonMw、NWO 与 MU Hybrid Art House 发起）的获奖与提名作品；该奖让艺术家和设计师与生物医学实验室合作。

把活的物质培育成材料、物件和结构。
Genetically modifying or programming organisms and cells.
对生物和细胞进行基因改造或编程。

用活的或生物材料进行打印、编织或机器人制造。
Building interfaces, sensors and computers that include living organisms.
构建包含活体生物的界面、传感器和计算机。

让非人类成为共同的制作者、表演者或设计者。

为照料、维系其他生命并与之共处而设计。
Making nonhuman perception, signals and communication perceptible to people.
让人能感知非人类的感知、信号和交流。
Imagining and critiquing possible futures through design fiction and critical design.
通过设计虚构和批判性设计来想象和质疑可能的未来。
Giving nonhumans agency, voice, ownership or rights.
赋予非人类能动性、发言权、所有权或权利。

超越人类的设计的框架、方法、综述与理论。

Networks, coalitions, communities and field-building initiatives.
Fellowships, residencies, courses, schools and accelerators.
Recurring conferences, workshops, summits and festivals.

Directories, archives, maps, databases and open datasets.
Companies and studios building in the field.
